correctness.rationale: Every associative F_q-derivation of M_n is inner. In odd characteristic an idempotent derivation has square-zero image as a two-sided ideal, hence zero. In characteristic two, ad(A)^2=ad(A^2), so idempotence forces A^2+A=cI, classifying split projection and irreducible quadratic implementers. For commuting idempotent ad(A),ad(B), [A,B] is scalar and lies in im(ad(A)) intersect ker(ad(A)), hence is zero. Counting B in split M_r x M_s or nonsplit M_m(F_{q^2}) centralizers, with q scalar-equivalent implementations, produces L,H,K and complete bivariate rank polynomial with balanced even-n boundaries. Independent F2 small n counts agree: n2 13 pairs, n3 253. Enumeration corroborates, not replaces all-field proof.
residual_risks: Counts labeled ordered derivations, not simultaneous-conjugacy grading classes.
For nonsplit conditional count the embedding multiplicities over F_{q^2} and scalar shifts must both be retained; both are handled in RESULT.
